messages:
morgan_partners: SentryBridge legal wants a single-plan doc for Marketplace listing + secrets integration (SSO/SAML, SCIM group sync, BYOK KMS). Need owners for tech checklist and launch.
alex_gg: I can own SAML and SCIM impl + automated tests. Please confirm required SCIM attributes (email, displayName, groups).
jamie_pm: I'll handle Marketplace package & docs (icons, screenshots, security blurb). Need product screenshots by EOD Wed.
sam_security: Security requirements: HSM attestation on onboarding, KMS key lifecycle and rotation policy, and exact telemetry we send (no secrets). I'll post a minimal template.
pat_sre: BYOK runbook: cert exchange flow, example terraform for customer KMS endpoint, and a fallback path to Redwood-managed keys with customer approval. Will draft.
lisa_sales: Sales needs a concise GTM line referencing SSO + SCIM + BYOK compliance. Quick draft coming.
ops-bot: created ticket INT-4891 https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INT-4891 (owner: morgan_partners)
morgan_partners: Proposed owners: Alex = SAML/SCIM + tests, Pat = BYOK ops + fallback, Sam = security signoff + attestation, Jamie = marketplace listing/docs, Lisa = GTM copy. Sync tomorrow 9am PT.
alex_gg: Quick SCIM curl example for test harness:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X GET "https://scim.sentrybridge.example.com/Users"
```
I also added expected SCIM group mapping in the ticket.
sam_security: BYOK must support HSM attestation and provide a signed proof document during onboarding. Retain audit logs 12 months. No plaintext key material in logs.
pat_sre: Fallback plan: automatic retry window 3m, then failover to managed-key path if customer toggles consent flag. We'll include SLA notes for Dedicated vs Hosted. Draft in INT-4891.
jamie_pm: Marketplace assets needed: 1-sentence summary, 250-char description, 3 screenshots (SSO setup, SCIM map, KMS config), security whitepaper PDF. Putting folder in drive.
morgan_partners: Drive link https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SentryBridge-Integration (editors: assigned). Tag me on changes.
lisa_sales: GTM one-liner draft: "SentryBridge + Redwood: unified SSO, automated user provisioning, and BYOK key controls for compliant inference." Sam: any redlines?
sam_security: Remove any explicit SLA or latency claims. Otherwise ok.
morgan_partners: Action items and due dates: Alex SCIM map (+3d), Pat BYOK + terraform sample (+5d), Sam attestation template (+1d), Jamie marketplace package (+4d), Lisa finalize GTM copy (+2d). I'll follow up in tomorrow sync 9am PT.
ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z for meeting "SentryBridge integration sync" (created by morgan_partners).
morgan_partners: Thanks team — if you update the drive ping me. :thumbsup:
